notes: Real Kimi Code 2.1.1 (the official installer's binary), in a tmux window (120x40; frame-* at 98x24, the size of the other fixtures' frame-* states), in a scratch HOME on a signed-out machine, `tmux capture-pane -e -p` fed through Gluon's screen model. No model was reachable and no prompt was sent: the session ran on an in-memory env model (KIMI_MODEL_PROVIDER_TYPE=openai, KIMI_MODEL_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9/v1 (nothing listens), a made-up key, KIMI_MODEL_NAME=moonshotai/kimi-k3, KIMI_CODE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1, KIMI_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1); the env model reaches the composer with no login nag. Text typed into the composer was never sent; never Enter on /clear or /compact. The path is scrubbed to ~/proj (column-preserving padding). Composer: a rounded box, `│ > <input> │` (continuation rows `│   <input> │`; kimi wraps long input by words), directly under the welcome box and notices, a footer row below it (model, folder, branch, a rotating tip; `plan` first when started with --plan; `context: 0% (0/256k)` under it). The cursor is an inverse cell in the composer row. A command typed whole shows a grey (136,136,136) hint after it (`/compact  <instruction>`): not input; typed text is the default colour, a command is bold blue. The slash menu is a panel BELOW the composer (no top border of its own: its first row follows the box's bottom border): rows `│   → name  description │` (highlighted) or `│     name  description │`, a skill or an alias in the list (`new (clear)`: /clear is /new's alias; `settings (config)`), long descriptions wrap onto rows indented the same, `(n/m)` last; it scrolls. Tab on `/cl` writes the canonical `/new` into the box (no run). The first start in a folder asks `Trust this folder?` (frame-trust-dialog: a full-width rule above and below, `↑↓ navigate · Enter select · Esc exit`, Trust / Don't trust; Esc or Don't trust exits kimi): there is no composer then. Every state but that one was captured in an already trusted folder (Enter on Trust once, in the scratch HOME). frame-explore-idle: started with --agent-file (Gluon's explore file): nothing different on screen. plan-flag-idle: --plan only adds `plan` before the model in the footer. frame-plan-approval (text-only (no colours), from real sessions of 2026-10-06: the interior of Gluon's frame as its text capture showed it. The cursor was not captured: hidden at the last cell): the plan-mode approval, no composer: "Ready to build with this plan?" with Approve / Reject / Revise (the row said Working for over a minute). frame-plan-alternatives, frame-cmd-approval and frame-cmd-approval-wrapped (2.1.1, BUG-611 follow-up; text-only from a live run of 2026-10-07 through OpenRouter, the interior of Gluon's frame as its text capture showed it; the cursor was not captured: hidden at the last cell): Kimi's other selection prompts, each a `▶ <question>` title, a numbered option list (the `▶` marks the highlighted one) and `↑/↓ select · 1/…/N choose · ↵ confirm` with N the option count, between two full-width rules and above the footer, no composer. frame-plan-alternatives: the plan approval when the plan offers alternatives (`Ready to build with this plan?`, three plan options, then Reject and Revise: N=5). frame-cmd-approval: `Run this command?` with the cwd and the command: Approve once / Approve for this session / Reject / Reject with feedback (N=4). frame-cmd-approval-wrapped: the same with a wrapped command, after plan mode ended (no `plan` in the footer, `ctrl+o expand` at its end). frame-question-panel, frame-question-panel-wrapped, frame-question-panel-described and frame-question-streaming (BUG-663; text-only from a live run of 2026-10-07 on Kimi Code 2.1.1 through OpenRouter, plan mode, in a tmux window at 100x30 and then 60 columns; the interior of Gluon's frame as its text capture showed it, so no colour runs and the cursor was not captured: hidden at the last cell): Kimi's `question` panel (its question tool), no composer, a full-width rule above and below it and the footer right under the lower one. Rows, top down: `question` alone, a blank row, the tab row (`README scope    Submit`: the question's own tab, then Submit), a blank row, `? <the question>` (wrapped, indented under the `?`, at 58 columns), a blank row, the options `[1]`…`[N]` (`→` marks the highlighted one, the others are indented the same; frame-question-panel-described: each option has a description line under it, indented eight spaces, from a second run), a blank row and the hints `↑↓ select  1-3 / ↵ choose  ←/→/tab switch  esc cancel`. The row said Working for over four minutes. frame-question-panel-wrapped: Kimi redrew the same panel at 60 columns. frame-question-streaming: the same turn a few seconds in, the empty composer on screen (no panel): not a pick. frame-early-composer, frame-early-composer-typed, frame-ready-composer and frame-llm-not-set (BUG-674; text-only from Gluon's launches of 2026-10-07 on Kimi Code 2.1.1 through OpenRouter with the model in KIMI_MODEL_* env, the interior of Gluon's frame as its text capture showed it; the cursor was not captured: hidden at the last cell): after the folder-trust dialog Kimi draws its empty composer at the top FIRST (frame-early-composer: no welcome banner, no footer), and 0.1 to 1 s later the banner above it (its `Model:` line) and the footer under it (`moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code thinking  <folder>  <branch>`) once it has applied the env model (frame-ready-composer; the composer moved down). A line typed into the early composer (frame-early-composer-typed: Gluon's brief) can reach Kimi before its model is set; under heavy CPU load Kimi then answered `Error: LLM not set, send "/login" to login` and dropped the line (frame-llm-not-set: 1 launch in 5 under load, 0 in 10 otherwise).
